score_definitions.cone_mean_angle: mean_t alpha_t, alpha_t = arccos(<h_t, mu> / (||h_t|| ||mu||)); radians
score_definitions.cone_coverage: share of tokens with alpha_t <= alpha_0.95 of the same text

layer_numbering: entry i is hidden_states[i]: 0 = embedding output; 1..L = transformer-layer outputs
auroc_orientation: score as written, label 1 = machine; AUROC below 0.5 means the score is lower for machine text

skip10pct.definition: all but the first 10% of tokens

med5.definition: tokens with ||h_t|| > 5 * median_t ||h_t|| dropped (per text and layer)

med10.definition: tokens with ||h_t|| > 10 * median_t ||h_t|| dropped (per text and layer)
